devpath.description: Path to the HIDRAW device node for the Logitech Unifying receiver. Corresponds to the -d option in ltunify(1).

pair_timeout.description: Default timeout in seconds for the 'pair' command. Must be between 1 and 255. 0 defaults to 30s.

unpair_devices.description: List of devices to unpair. Each item is a flat object with an 'id' field corresponding to the device index or name (Keyboard, Mouse, etc.).
